values.description: JWT access token. Set this after Telegram login or paste a token manually.
Auto-set after creating a category via Admin > Create Category, or from Get All Categories.
Auto-set after creating a job via Jobs > Create Job.
Auto-set after creating an application via Applications > Create Application.
Auto-set after initiating checkout via Payments > Initiate Checkout.
Worker profile UUID. Set manually after getting it from Workers > Get All Workers.
Review UUID. Set manually after getting it from Reviews > Get Reviews.
Notification UUID. Set manually after getting it from Notifications > Get Notifications.
User UUID for admin role updates. Set manually from Admin > Get All Users.
HMAC-SHA256 signature for webhook simulation. Generate from CHAPA_ENCRYPTION_KEY + payload.
